service.description: Records an ADM Customs Declaration (Prospetto di Riepilogo Contabile della dichiarazione doganale) based on EUCDM messages (H1-H7). Automatically creates the customs VAT entry in the Purchase VAT Register (Registro IVA Acquisti) for the deductible import VAT (Codice tributo 421).

service-call.name: mantle.account.InvoiceServices.create#Invoice
service-call.in-map: { fromPartyId: 'IT_ADM', toPartyId: organizationPartyId, invoiceTypeEnumId: 'InvoiceSales', invoiceDate: declarationDate, currencyUomId: 'EUR', referenceNumber: 'Prospetto Doganale MRN ' + mrn, description: 'Importazione beni EUCDM ' + declarationTypeEnumId + ' - MRN: ' + mrn + ' (Dogana ' + (customsOfficeId || 'ADM') + ')', statusId: 'InvoiceApproved' }

service-call.name: mantle.account.InvoiceServices.create#InvoiceItem
service-call.in-map: { invoiceId: vatRegisterInvoiceId, itemTypeEnumId: 'ItemTax', description: 'IVA Importazione Doganale (Cod. 421) - Imponibile ' + customsTaxableValue + ' EUR', quantity: 1, amount: importVatAmount, taxableAmount: customsTaxableValue, taxPercentage: 22.0, taxAuthorityId: 'IT_ADM', taxAuthorityRateId: 'IT_VAT_22' }

service-call.name: mantle.account.InvoiceServices.update#Invoice
